text:
harper: Quick non-work question — hypothetical: you get one extra free weekend this year (no meetings, no chores, totally free). What do you actually DO with it? Camping? Build something? Take a class? Tell me your plan :sparkles:

maya: Backpacking + zero signal. Two nights, a tiny stove, and a hardcover. Pure recharge. :mountain:

sam: Automate my caffeine intake. Build a tiny rolling espresso robot. Name: Baristabot. It would have a PID controller and a smug latte art routine.

josie: Weekend pottery crash course. Been wanting to try the wheel for ages. Anyone here tried it?

claire: I did a one-day wheel workshop once — my bowl looked like a hat but I loved it. Bring an old shirt/apron. :pottery_wheel: (:thumbsup: josie)

ramon: Finally finish the 1k-word sci-fi short I keep abandoning. Also maybe deep-clean my synths and make a little jam.

sam: @harper if Baristabot's open-source I'll contribute a voice module that nags you politely until you take a break.

maya: low-key want to try wild swimming but also slightly terrified of cold water. Anyone done it?

claire: Wild swim yes! Start with a wetsuit and a friend. Best adrenaline reset.

devbot: Note: company offsite RSVP reminder sent to #all — not related but a friendly ping.

harper: Love all of these. Bonus question: what one item are you bringing that makes the weekend 10x better? Mine: a tiny travel kettle — hot tea = solved.

josie: My item: a chunk of good chocolate. Instant mood upgrade.

ramon: Portable MIDI controller so I can noodle and actually finish something.

sam: Mini espresso kit (obviously).

maya: Earplugs + a paperback. Quiet is underrated.

claire: Sunscreen. I am the person who burns on cloudy days.

harper: Thanks team — putting these in my fantasy weekend plan. If folks want, we can swap pics after our next real weekend off :camera_with_flash:
